purpose: Add a bounded defensive route that proves or rejects attacker-controlled source-to-agentic-sink paths in CI without running target workflows.
mechanismsStudied: event expression transport into an AI prompt
privileged target-context checkout of untrusted code
firstPartyAdvances: requires an explicit source transport sink authority consequence chain
separates amplifiers from proven injection findings
continues bounded local reusable workflows while failing closed on unavailable remote evidence
records rejected hypotheses and residual coverage gaps
preserves effect authority and never invokes inspected workflows
limitations: fixture evaluation does not prove arbitrary workflow coverage
remote action internals require separately authorized exact evidence
static review does not prove runtime safety or absence of platform behavior
